mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP450 enzymes (1A2, 2C9, 2D6, 3A4) while echinacea may induce CYP3A4, creating opposing metabolic effects and potential for variable echinacea levels and reduced cimetidine efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced cimetidine effectiveness and variable echinacea efficacy; consider alternative H2-blocker if concurrent use is necessary, and counsel on inconsistent herbal product standardization.
